# 00000003762

**English.** Definition: The Beilinson spectral sequence: decomposition of derived sheaves. Conjecture: Beilinson decomposition: the derived category of projective space is generated by exceptional sequences of line bundles, with the length of sequences binomial coefficients. (Beilinson exceptional sequence binomial generation length)

**中文。** 定义：Beilinson 谱序列：导出层的分解。猜想：Beilinson 分解：射影空间的导出范畴的生成为线丛的例外序列且序列的长度为二项式系数。（Beilinson 例外序列二项式生成长度）
